$comment: Platform preference (card xx0055i). roundCapAction person|takeover: at the fix round cap, takeover = dispatch ONE takeover fix (full round history, top claude rung of the fixer ladder) before asking the operator; person = ask the operator at once (tool override env WE_FIX_ROUND_CAP_ACTION). roundHistory on|off: a round N>1 fix brief carries the previous-rounds section (env WE_FIX_ROUND_HISTORY). takeoverMaxPerPr: how many takeovers one PR may get (env WE_FIX_TAKEOVER_MAX_PER_PR). Ruling disputes always go to the operator. See scripts/conveyor/fix-takeover.mjs and scripts/conveyor/fix-round-history.mjs.
